# Stack Seekers

> Stack Seekers is an Enterprise Architecture Partner and Fractional CTO consultancy led by Jiwan Ghosal. We specialize in architecting high-performance digital products, scaling complex web platforms, and implementing AI-driven automation for startups and global enterprises.

## Services

- [Figma to Web](https://stackseekers.com/web-development-services/figma-to-web/) - Converting designs into functional, dynamic websites using Vue.js/React.js.
- [E-commerce Solutions](https://stackseekers.com/web-development-services/e-commerce-solutions/) - Building robust, scalable online stores.
- [Consulting & Technical Advisory](https://stackseekers.com/web-development-services/consulting-and-technical-advisory/) - Expert guidance for projects and technical challenges.
- [Custom Web Development](https://stackseekers.com/web-development-services/custom-web-development/) - Web apps tailored to business needs.
- [API Development](https://stackseekers.com/web-development-services/api-development-and-integration/) - Creating RESTful APIs and integrating third-party services.
- [CI/CD](https://stackseekers.com/web-development-services/ci-cd/) - Designing pipelines with Jenkins, GitLab CI, and GitHub Actions.
- [Hosting & Deployment](https://stackseekers.com/web-development-services/hosting/) - Cloud infrastructure setup (AWS/Azure) and containerization.

## Products & Projects

- [Contact Form Plugin](https://contact-form-app.stackseekers.com/)
  - **Problem**: Custom contact forms usually require backend code and database setup.
  - **Solution**: A drop-in widget that sends submissions directly to a Notion database.
  - **Price**: Free

- [Vibe3](https://vibe3.vibesquad.co)
  - **Problem**: Brands struggle to find relevant influencers; Creators struggle to manage campaigns.
  - **Solution**: AI-powered matching platform with campaign management and Web3 payments.
  - **Target**: Brands, Influencers, Marketers.

- [Dynamic CRUD App](https://notion-crud.netlify.app/)
  - **Problem**: Building admin panels for Notion databases is time-consuming.
  - **Solution**: Instantly turns any Notion database into a professional CRUD web application.
  - **Price**: Free

- [Free AI Voice Generator & Text to Speech (Gemini)](https://ainarrator.stackseekers.com/)
  - **Problem**: Creating professional voiceovers is expensive and requires specialized software.
  - **Solution**: Google Docs add-on that converts text to natural-sounding AI speech.
  - **Price**: Free

- [Service Request System](https://notion-p.netlify.app/)
  - **Problem**: Managing customer service requests often requires expensive ticketing software.
  - **Solution**: A complete ticketing system using Notion as the backend and Netlify for hosting.
  - **Price**: Free

- [Appliance Repair Platform](https://appliancerepairly.com)
  - **Problem**: Finding reliable local appliance repair information and professionals is difficult.
  - **Solution**: A directory and troubleshooting guide for home appliances.

- [SR-22 Insurance Now](https://sr22insurancenow.com/)
  - **Problem**: Finding affordable SR-22 insurance is confusing and opaque.
  - **Solution**: A comparison platform specifically for high-risk insurance needs.

- [Momentum Incident Management](https://momentum-chi-brown.vercel.app/)
  - **Problem**: IT incident tracking tools are often bloated and expensive.
  - **Solution**: A streamlined, nested-table incident management system.
